news_trading: Restricted: in evaluation, holding through news is allowed but deliberately trading news is prohibited. On Master (funded) accounts, profit from trades opened/closed within ±5 min of restricted news may be deducted (trades opened 5h+ before are excluded). Zero Master: no holding/opening/closing within ±10 min of restricted news (account closure)
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: third-party EAs only as trade/risk managers; fully automated personal EAs allowed with proof of ownership; all EAs prohibited in the Monthly Competition
copy_trading: Restricted: copying between different users and copying into FundingPips from an external source are prohibited; using a FundingPips account as master for an external account is allowed (investor password)
overnight_weekend_holding: Evaluation: overnight and weekend allowed. Master (1 Step Flex, 2 Step Standard, 2 Step Flex, 2 Step Pro): not allowed by default (daily auto-close around 20:45 UTC summer / 21:45 UTC winter) unless a holding add-on is bought. Zero Master: positions must be closed before the weekend, or the account is terminated
restricted_countries_note: Help center: no service to residents of FATF and EU/UN sanctions-list countries, Vietnam and UAE; full list not read. https://help.fundingpips.com/hc/en-us/articles/34505029138449-Trading-Conduct-and-Security-Standards

affiliate_program.notes: Help center links a 'Become an Affiliate' article; it could not be read (rate limit).
